name: Will my homeowner's insurance cover the cost of a flooded garage cleanup?

mainEntity.name: Will my homeowner's insurance cover the cost of a flooded garage cleanup?

acceptedAnswer.text: Homeowner's insurance coverage for a flooded garage depends on the cause of the flooding and your specific policy. Generally, sudden and accidental events like a burst pipe or appliance malfunction are covered. However, damage from external flooding, such as heavy rain or overflowing rivers, typically requires a separate flood insurance policy. It's crucial to review your policy or contact your insurance provider directly to understand your coverage details.
acceptedAnswer.description: Coverage depends on your policy and the flood's cause; sudden incidents are often covered, but external floods usually require separate flood insurance.
